propositions: Three pagination loops in acli_graph.py hand-roll identical cursor-traversal logic with no runaway-token guard, allowing a server that repeats the same nextPageToken to spin indefinitely (cabc bug class).
The offset-protocol pager (fetcher._iter_pages) includes same-page/stall guards that are absent from the three cursor loops; cursor pagination deserves equivalent hardening at a shared seam.

A shared cursor iterator must emit RunawayPaginationError when the server returns the same non-null token twice consecutively, and this error must escape the maps' fail-open exception handlers to prevent silent partial-dict returns.

Each map's fail-open handler (except Exception: break) must gain an except RunawayPaginationError: raise arm ahead of the catch-all to treat runaway as a data-integrity signal rather than a degradable transport fault.
